# P07 repair checkpoint

Scope: MC04, MC25, MC27, MC34 within G17/G18. Approved plan:
`data/accounting-master/runs/20261003T024539-18803fb0/P07/approved-plan.json`.
The supplied structured recovery snapshot was verified against actual files.
No raw worker logs were used. Prior timeout artifacts were not accepted blindly.

Skeptical repair audit retained actual P05 execution and the independent journal/
statement verifier as matched comparators. Exact equivalence is the criterion;
partial commits, stale reuse, changed historical results and missing lineage
veto acceptance. Timing/test counts are descriptive; no economic defaults changed.

Repaired confirmed defects: rational payload hash mismatch; late descendants
escaping supersession; missing output invalidation edges; non-atomic initial
schema creation; migration with immutable legacy triggers; absent migration
foreign-key/replay validation. Explicit event phases now distinguish identities.
Source checks follow run dependencies. Invalid review dates are typed rejections.
The checker preserves actual fault observations and corrected economic outputs.
